introduction: Apply for NJ SNAP through MyNJHelps or your County Social Service Agency. The county reviews eligibility and provides interview and verification instructions.
description: Apply for NJ SNAP through MyNJHelps or your County Social Service Agency. The county reviews eligibility and provides interview and verification instructions.

sections.who: The assessment considers household income, expenses, circumstances and applicable participation rules. Older adults, disabled applicants and students may have different provisions; an online screening result is not an approval.
sections.get: Approved households receive food benefits through Families First EBT. The decision explains the award and ongoing requirements.

sections.apply:
1. Apply through the current portal

    Use MyNJHelps, or bring, mail or fax a paper application to the county agency.

  2. Complete county follow-up

    Keep the interview and respond to the specific proof request. Ask about urgent food needs when applying.

  3. Check the decision and account

    Use MyNJHelps to view status, upload records and manage reporting.
sections.after: Use current county guidance rather than the income chart still labeled October 2025–September 2026. Ask a listed SNAP Navigator for free application assistance if needed.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using NJ SNAP application routes, Eligibility categories and current work-rule guidance, Current MyNJHelps case features. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is NJHelps screening the same as MyNJHelps application?
No. Screening estimates eligibility; MyNJHelps accepts and manages applications.
Can someone assist an older or disabled applicant?
The state allows an authorized representative, such as a friend or family member, to apply on their behalf.
Should I pay a consultant to apply?
The state says SNAP application assistance is free. Use the county or a listed Navigator.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
